== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Storm [[madra]] is a versatile and potent form of energy characterized by its association with lightning, [[wind]], and thunder. It is frequently manifested in various colors, including blue, yellow, [[sapphire]], and multicolored lightning that can appear as dense or tangible as [[royal madra]]. This energy is used by various practitioners, such as the [[Stormcaller]] and the [[Sage of Calling Storms]], to execute techniques ranging from massive lightning blasts and electrical serpents to specialized [[constructs]] like flying falcons or [[dragons]]. Beyond individual techniques, storm [[madra]] can manifest as large-[[scale]] natural phenomena, such as massive storms that blot out the sky or rivers of energy that crash down upon targets. It is also linked to powerful entities and artifacts; for instance, the [[Storm Core]] serves as a source of this power, giving rise to natural spirits shaped like massive stormclouds with lightning-molded limbs. [[Weeping Dragon|The Weeping Dragon]] utilizes storm [[madra]] to create millions of tiny, serpentine [[dragons]] that seek out and consume spiritual power. Additionally, the energy can be woven together from many lesser [[aspects]] to create complex, tangible forms of lightning.}}
